claims: The file shows a TCS Sydney Marathon 2026 finisher medal held in the photographer's hand; the ribbon reads "TCS SYDNEY MARATHON presented by asics", and the medal rim includes "2026".

The uploader and author is Tameem Mahmud 007, credited as own work.
